title: The plugin marketplace; R&D's measurement agents from the chat; two page bugs every person would hit
request: The owner's goal: Claude Code's capabilities (its plugin marketplace) and every R&D agent behind the chat, in sync with R&D on GitHub.
plan: list every plugin of every marketplace, searchable
install at the marketplace's pinned commit into DCLab Code's own folder
reach the team of roles and the learning scoreboard as commands the person approves; live-check them

decisions.decision: install into DCLab Code's own folder, never Claude Code's
decisions.why: Claude Code keeps its own records of what it installed; writing there could break it

decisions.decision: fetch the commit the marketplace pins (a sha), and say when a source pins none
decisions.why: the person gets exactly what the marketplace lists, not whatever the repository holds today

decisions.decision: git with hooks off, no file or ext protocols, no prompts, no LFS smudge
decisions.why: a fetch must never run the repository's code

decisions.decision: the orchestra spike stays explained, not wired
decisions.why: a prototype with no command line, replaced by the two teams the chat reaches

change: dclab-code server/plugins.js (marketplaces, install, remove, symlink-safe), server/app.js (POST /api/settings/plugins, inClaudeCode), web/* (search, Install, Remove, marketplaces, restart reload, click fix), sync/agents.json, scripts/sync-check.js, tests, docs.

findings.defect: Install could move a folder out of the person's home, and Remove then delete it
findings.scenario: a plugin repository holds a link a -> ../../../.. and its entry is git-subdir a/.ssh: ~/.ssh was renamed into the plugins folder (verified in a scratch home)
findings.cause: the path checks compared text; rename follows links inside a path
findings.fix: the source must be a real folder whose resolved path is inside the fetched copy; a marketplace folder linked outside is never listed
findings.test: server test with links to a temp 'victim' folder; undoing either check fails it

findings.defect: after one marketplace action the Add button stayed disabled
findings.scenario: add one marketplace, then try a second
findings.cause: buttons re-enabled only on failure; Add is a fixed element

findings.defect: a plugin on in Claude Code could load twice
findings.scenario: enabled in Claude Code, then installed and ticked here
findings.cause: inClaudeCode was only set for plugins on disk
findings.fix: shown on and locked; install and tick refused

findings.defect: install failed with a raw TypeError when two entries shared a name
findings.scenario: one folder entry and one repository entry named x
findings.cause: the first entry of that name was taken

findings.defect: a reconnect after a refused stream skipped reloading the state
findings.scenario: the stream closes for another reason; events in the gap lost

findings.defect: removing an added marketplace could delete plugins from a Claude Code marketplace of the same name
no checkbox in the Settings sheet could be ticked by a click
findings.scenario: click 'Only DCLab's MCP server' or a plugin's tick: nothing changes
findings.cause: the backdrop's onclick returned false for clicks inside the sheet, which cancels the click
findings.fix: block bodies (also the palette and a tool row)
findings.test: page test clicks two checkboxes; the old handler fails it

findings.defect: after a server restart the page waited forever
findings.scenario: npm start again: the page shows 'Reconnecting…' and every button fails
findings.cause: the new token refuses the old page's stream and the browser stops retrying
findings.fix: on a refusal the page checks; on 401 it reloads, keeping an unsent message
findings.test: page test restarts the server on the same port; fails without the fix

findings.defect: sync-check could not reach a command that is a module file
findings.fix: a module file with a main block counts

measurements.name: live
measurements.gate: team and learning run from the chat; nothing spent or stored; R&D unchanged
measurements.result: team showed its plan; learning ran 2 check variants (1 passed); R&D's git status identical; $0.09

measurements.name: tests
measurements.gate: every test passes; each guard's test fails when the guard is undone
measurements.result: dclab-code 117 of 117; both symlink checks, the click fix and the restart reload each caught by their tests

outcome: The person can browse, install, tick and remove Claude Code plugins and marketplaces in DCLab Code, safely; every R&D agent is reached or has a stated reason.
lessons: A path check on text is no check where links exist: resolve real paths before a move or a delete.
An onclick that returns false cancels the click: write handlers with block bodies.
Test a restart: a token per start strands every open page.
risks: no real plugin was installed from GitHub (it downloads third-party code: the owner's choice)
